Subterfuge is a diverse skill, encompassing abilities ranging from the secret rattle that those of serpentine ambitions may use to communicate with each other, to archery, the conjuring of [[illusion|illusions]], dimensional [[wormhole|wormholes]], and various stealth and attack abilities.

The skill of '''Subterfuge''' is available to members of the [[Serpent]] [[class]], along with [[Venom_(Skill)|Venom]] and [[Hypnosis]].

Furthermore, while it is difficult to do normally, if your target is fairly helpless (paralysed, tied up, frozen, fallen on the ground, sleeping, unconscious, or some other similar afflictions) then you will always hit with this. The higher your subterfuge, the more damage this ability will do.

{{Skill_detail

 |description=Create an illusion of your choosing.
 |lessons=534
 |syntax=CONJURE [target] ILLUSION <illusion>
 |required=25 mana
 |target=Adventurers and room
 |cooldown=1.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=Create an illusion of your choosing in the room you are in, optionally targeted at a specific person. You may conjure an illusion without balance, but this will increase the equilibrium cost to 3.1 seconds. It is also possible to bite someone immediately after conjuring your illusion, before your have recovered equilibrium. You may embed a single newline in your illusion by including the character sequence \n at the appropriate spot. For limitations and restrictions on illusions, please refer to HELP ILLUSIONS.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=[[Snakes|Snake]]
 |description=A pet snake to assist you in combat.
 |lessons=1634
 |syntax=SUMMON RATTLESNAKE<br>SUMMON RATTLESNAKE INVENTORY{{!}}INV
 |required=100 mana
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=5.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=The first time you summon a snake, you may have to try many times before you're successful. Eventually though, the snakes of the wild won't be able to resist your serpentine charms, and one will come slithering to serve. Once you have your snake, you may summon it back at any time should you lose it (simply SUMMON RATTLESNAKE INVENTORY{{!}}INV] again). Your snake may be ordered to perform the actions listed in HELP DENIZENS.<p>City/House membership influences what precisely is summoned.<br>'''Ashtan''' summon kraits.<br>'''CIJ''' summon puffadders.<br>'''Eleusis''' summon treesnakes.<br>'''Hashan''' summon vipers.<br>'''Mhaldor''' summon adders.<br>'''Targossas''' summon moccasins.<br>'''Cyrene''' summon lanceheads.<br>All others summon rattlesnakes.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Phase
 |description=Alter your status in space-time itself.
 |lessons=1736
 |syntax=PHASE<br>UNPHASE
 |required=100 mana
 |target=Self
 |cooldown=4.00 seconds of balance
 |detail=This is probably the most effective concealment ability there is. While phased, you will be hidden from all mortal adventurers, aside from other phased ones. You will, further, be unable to interact with items, denizens, or unphased adventurers. The caveat here is that you may try to attack an unphased adventurer, which will automatically unphase you. Thus, phase can be used as an effective aid to assassinations.<p>Be warned that you will lose endurance rather quickly while phased.</p>
}}
